svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.venus-interior-model", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introductory inferred Venus interior model with an aggregate iron core, surrounding hot-rock mantle and an explicitly exaggerated thin rocky crust, leaving unresolved internal core state unencoded. Introduced outer radius120mm, core62mm, mantle outer114mm and6mm crust. The6mm crust is deliberately exaggerated; neither62:114:120 nor core phase is certified by NASA. No quantitative Earth/Venus radius comparison is taught. Each named planet independently scaled to240mm diameter; equal display size does not imply equal planetary diameter or measured interplanetary size comparison. Material/planet names require an accessible external context key;black boundaries/white annuli/native samples andheight roles do not intrinsically name a planet ormaterial. Regions between lines are material intervals,not empty holes. Phase subdivisions unmodelled,not asserted absent. No atmosphere,crater decoration,label-box cavities oractual physical-touch/recognition claim.", "geometry_exception": "Index native1.2mm line-sampling dots with3.1mm centre guard;shared junctions de-duplicated. Independent introductory planet-interior lessons with external named/material keys;phase boundaries unmodelled,not absent. No material or recognition code inherent in an outline.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}
